results.title: Where in the world is al-Qaida's leader? | Brookings
results.content:
The emir of al-Qaida, Ayman al-Zawahiri, has not made any public statements since September 2014.
Al-Zawahiri was chosen by Osama bin Laden to be his successor.
Al-Zawahiri designated Yemeni Nasir al-Wuhayshi—leader of al-Qaida in the Arabian Peninsula—to be his successor in 2013.
Why is al-Zawahiri missing in action?
Perhaps al-Zawahiri is ill and his health precludes any public role.
More likely his silence is deliberate.
